_comment: Phase-0 CI ratchet guards enforce architecture migration. Each domain tracks legacy dispatch status and expected types. Guards (check_file_size.py, check_single_dispatch.py, check_registry_completeness.py) use this manifest to gate commits. Domains with status='pending' are not yet enforced (pass); status='migrated' requires the legacy dispatch function to be absent (legacy_dispatch) and/or the legacy dispatch registry to be empty (legacy_registry), plus complete type coverage (expected_types resolve to _REGISTRY ports). NOTE: DUST_EMISSION_MODELS survives as an internal HDF5 loader cache (not a dispatch table); the honest single-dispatch invariant is the ABSENCE of the resolve_emission_model dispatch function, so dust_emission uses legacy_dispatch, not legacy_registry.

dust_attenuation._comment: Dust attenuation dispatches via the _REGISTRY seam (#844). The attenuator screens (DustSEDComponent/DustAttenuationSEDComponent/WG00AttenuationSEDComponent) register in _REGISTRY from their own modules; build_components selects the class via _resolve_registry_component, so it no longer imports the attenuator CLASSES (only their config dataclasses). The single-dispatch invariant is the ABSENCE of a directly-imported attenuator class in component_factory — DustSEDComponent is the representative sentinel; the behavioral contract test (test_dust_attenuation_single_dispatch) covers all three types.

radio._comment: RadioSEDComponent registers in _REGISTRY from its own module; build_components resolves it via _resolve_registry_component (single dispatch, #845), so it no longer imports the class (only RadioSEDComponentConfig at the call site). Construction-only convergence — apply() and its cross-component reads (L_ir/L_agn_bol/log_mstar) are byte-identical. Sentinel = RadioSEDComponent absent from component_factory.

xray._comment: XRaySEDComponent dispatches via the _REGISTRY seam (#845). Construction-only; apply() cross-component reads (sfr/log_mstar/L_agn_bol/L_2500) unchanged. Sentinel = XRaySEDComponent absent from component_factory.

igm._comment: IGMSEDComponent (observer-frame transmission screen) dispatches via the _REGISTRY seam (#845). Construction-only; apply() unchanged. Sentinel = IGMSEDComponent absent from component_factory.

nebular._comment: NebularSEDComponent dispatches via the _REGISTRY seam (#845). Construction-only; the per-backend apply() (baked_in/cloudy_grid/cue/shock) and its cross-component reads (nion) are unchanged. Registering it surfaced (and this PR fixed) a default-hygiene backlog: the cue/cloudy/shock backends' free params (neb_logU, gas_logn, ionspec_index1..4, ionspec_logLratio1..3, shock_velocity, ...) now carry physical defaults (ionspec = 1-Myr solar-Z BPASS fit). Sentinel = NebularSEDComponent absent from component_factory.
